newsitem.title: USA: Netanyahu departs US after frank talks with Clinton.
newsitem.headline: Netanyahu departs US after frank talks with Clinton.

text.p: Israeli Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu departed the United States late on Monday after tough talks with President Bill Clinton aimed at reviving the stalled peace process.
A military spokesman confirmed that Netanyahu's Israeli Air Force jet left Andrews Air Force Base at 22:49 p.m. EDT (0249 GMT).

Clinton described his two-hour meeting with Netanyahu as "specific, frank, candid" suggesting little progress, but Netanyahu later told a packed American Israel Public Affairs Committee dinner the conversation was "excellent".
